$comment:
REQ-CBT-008: each status owns its stacking rules. REQ-CBT-009: soft and hard CC tiers, with bosses resisting and diminishing. Only the statuses the prototype's cards and monsters actually reference are defined — a status nothing can apply is dead content.

REQ-CBT-010: generic status resistance is a BOSS system. Normal hunters and normal enemies have no blanket resistance stat; they rely on immunities and specific conditions instead.

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.$magnitudeNote: Fraction of the applier's attack per tick.

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.$stackingNote: Bleed stacks so that a pack applying it repeatedly becomes a real problem, unlike burn which only refreshes.

diminishing.$comment: REQ-CBT-009. Each application within the window is shorter than the last; a boss cannot be chain-stunned.
